title: RBI releases the results of Forward Looking Surveys
description: The Reserve Bank of India today released on its website the results of the following Surveys: Urban Consumer Confidence Survey (UCCS) – July 2026 Inflation Expectations Survey of Households (IESH) – July 2026 Rural Consumer Confidence Survey (RCCS) – July 2026 Survey of Professional Forecasters on Macroeconomic Indicators - Results of the 101st Round1 Order Books, Inventories and Capacity Utilisation Survey on the Manufacturing sector for Q4:2025-26 Industrial Outlook Survey of
